evidence.observation: Tube pressure was 3.00 Torr at the start of growth, in line with the steady ~2.97 Torr seen during the ramp.
Pressure rose steadily to 3.34 Torr (+11% in 480 s), about 0.08 Torr per event, and is still rising.
Argon flow is steady at ~100 sccm, so the flow did not change enough to explain the pressure rise.
Temperature settled at 750 °C after a small overshoot; heater power is normal.
The exhaust O2 sensor is not installed, but the growth stage requires it, so the atmosphere cannot be verified.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a leak-up/rate-of-rise test with flow stopped) would tell a seal leak (air getting in) from an exhaust blockage. Checking the exhaust line or pump conductance would also help, as would normal-run reference values for pressure during growth.
